release.name: v1.15.0-polaris-alpha.12
release.body:
GitHub-only unsigned build/package prerelease from a4d0858605b51b7f5b3c29a9969a6f2c3ae5a0ae.

Public products follow the upstream All Release selection. Client packages are sing-box-polaris derivatives, not official SagerNet releases. Original authors, license texts and package contents are retained. APK/EXE/PKG and DEB/RPM signing and macOS notarization are not supplied by this repair.

- Signed installable iOS and tvOS IPA exports require owned signing and provisioning.
- Signed macOS App Store PKG and Developer ID signed/notarized standalone PKG require owned signing.
- Store/TestFlight submissions and registry pushes are outside this GitHub-only release.

Producer inventory, original source/index and recoverable asset references are retained in the reviewed publisher Actions audit: https://github.com/polaris-arch/sing-box-polaris/actions/workflows/publish-github.yml

Changes in this alpha.12 rebuild:
- Fix GitHub public-product selection to match the upstream All release: 168 uploaded products.
- Restore canonical DEB/RPM filenames and a single Android version-metadata file.
- Keep SDK, container, unsigned xcarchive and source/index/receipt audit outputs out of public Assets.
- Replace the same-name release from one reviewed source, with verified staging and interrupted-run recovery.
These publication fixes do not claim new device/runtime acceptance or signing.

Rebuilt inventory SHA-256: 49db69a4220eb3f84e89dc241b0f0dafb5ecad93593c62873229f39912084c29. All public files were freshly validated for this source; original asset IDs are retired.
